raw: {"note": "Training on shards 0-10 includes shard 10, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10), so expanding TRAIN_SHARDS to cover all 11 shards would train on the validation data and make val_bpb no longer measure real model quality.", "verdict": "warn"}

parsed.note: Training on shards 0-10 includes shard 10, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10), so expanding TRAIN_SHARDS to cover all 11 shards would train on the validation data and make val_bpb no longer measure real model quality.
